full_judgment: 2. The appellants, as plaintiffs, instituted Title Suit No. 85 of 1995 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Naria, Shariatpur against the defendant-respondent Nos. 1 to 13 praying for a declaration that the ex-parte decree dated 25-7-1989 passed in Title Suit No. 41 of 1988 is null and void, fraudulent, collusive, inoperative and not binding upon the plaintiffs. The plaintiffs' case, in short, is that Mohendra Chandra Karati, Kamini Bewa, Sona Bewa and Sitalazmi Bewa were the owners of 4.11 acres of land of RS Khatian No. 197 of mouja Panchagaon, Police Station-Naria. That Mahendra Chandra Karati-who was the owner in possession of the 8 anas share transferred some land to Tarai Haider and others by a registered kabala dated 6-11-1975; Mahendra Chandra Karati sold out his rest land to Nurjahan Begum by registered saf-kabala dated 19-12-1975 and put her in possession of the said land. That Nurjahan Begum while owning and possessing that land sold out 24 decimals of land to the plaintiff No. 1 and 6 decimals of land to the plaintiff No. 2 by registered saf-kabalas dated 23-4-1983. That Arab Ali Howlader and others while were owners in possession of the land in plot No. 1846 sold out 10 decimals of land by registered kabala dated 26-11-1986 to the predecessor of the plaintiff Nos. 4 to 14. That Elahi Box Mridha-another purchaser of the suit land died leaving behind two daughters, namely Nasima Khatun and Hazera Khatun and wife Shamsun Nahar and the said heirs of Elahi Box Mirdha sold out 32 decimals of land of suit plot No. 1846 to the plaintiff No. 3 by registered kabalas dated 18-4-1987. That proforma-defendant No. 12 Khalil Mridha has been in possession of 10 decimals of land in the suit plot by purchase. The plaintiffs further case was that Dhirendra Chandra Mondal and others, as plaintiffs, instituted Title Suit No. 124 of 1987 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Naria impleading the plaintiffs and others as defendants, but that suit was ultimately dismissed for default on 7-2-1987. That the plaintiffs while were in peaceful possession of the suit land came to know on 4th Bhadra 1402 BS from one Kadir Box Mirdha that the predecessor of the defendants, namely, Taleb Ali Saiyal obtained an ex-parte decree in respect of the suit land and upon making necessary inquires the plaintiffs learnt that Taleb Ali Saiyal instituted Title Suit No. 41 of 1988 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Naria, Shariatpur impleading Mahendra Chandra Karati, an Indian citizen and the Deputy Commissioner, Shariatpur as defendant Nos. 1 and 2 and obtained an ex-parte decree on 25-7-1989 falsely showing the service of summons and without impleading the plaintiffs and the defendants of Title Suit No. 124 of 1987. The plaintiffs alleged that they did not know anything about the ex-parte decree passed in Title Suit No. 41 of 1988.
